scope: Cross-module control-plane increment for durable native task state, desktop task status rendering, and bounded project image edits.
implemented: Windows reconciliation marks an unowned persisted running native task as interrupted while preserving a live lock owner.
Native project reuse accepts an explicit editReplacementAssetId, reads it from the frozen project, verifies its content hash and image kind, and records it in the authorization inputs.
ImageRect local edits replace only the selected rectangle, publish a deterministic PNG media result, and retain parent/replacement input references.
Desktop tool responses render validated native task states with job IDs for current and historical messages.
known_limits: time_range editing remains fail-closed until a native audio/video editor exists.
